page.overview:
Who is Baron Vladimir Harkonnen?

For adaption and Canon equivalents, see Vladimir Harkonnen (disambiguation)

Siridar-Baron Vladimir Harkonnen (/ˈhɑːrkənən/) (10110 AG - December 10193 AG) was the penultimate ruler of House Harkonnen and chief architect behind the demise of Duke Leto Atreides during the final reigning years of Padishah Emperor Shaddam IV. Aided by his nephews, "Beast” Rabban and Feyd-Rautha, and his mentat, Piter de Vries, Vladimir conspired for their House to dominate Arrakis and eventually the Golden Lion Throne before their ultimate defeat by House Atreides and their Fremen legions during the Desert War - an event which ousted House Harkonnen, House Corrino and even the Spacing Guild from their positions of power.

Vladimir had possessed no male heirs of his own, though he did sire a daughter through the Bene Gesserit breeding program in his youth. To accommodate for this, Vladimir effectively adopted his youngest nephew, Feyd-Rautha, and raised him as his future successor. The Baron showered Feyd with praise and the promise of eventual leadership, and was also implied to have an incestual lust for his nephew, but his hold over the cunning and impulsive youth remained tenuous, with Feyd even attempting to assassinate him by planting a poison needle in the thigh of a young slave boy, knowing that was the spot his uncle was most likely to touch, which Harkonnen narrowly avoided due to the warnings of Thufir Hawat beforehand.

Meanwhile, the Baron found good use in his eldest nephew, Glossu Rabban, who, despite being considered too brutish and stupid by uncle, was eventually appointed planetary governor of Arrakis.

Also known as: Baron, Vladimir Harkonnen, the Baron.
